WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    ab.translink,
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) as count_records
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  INNER JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
  GROUP BY ab.translink, t.tradekind
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(count_records) as total_count
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.translink,
    s1.tradekind,
    s1.count_records,
    CAST(s1.count_records AS REAL) / s2.total_count as proportion
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s2.total_count IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  tradekind,
  AVG(count_records) as avg_count,
  AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion
FROM step3
GROUP BY tradekind
